scenarios.description: Server-side input validation rejects malformed master payloads with HTTP 422.
scenarios.threshold: 100% of 7 malformed-input variants return HTTP 422 (none returns 5xx or 2xx)
scenarios.details: Pydantic schemas at the API boundary reject empty strings on supplier_name, place, staff_name, dealer_name, grade_code, size, design_name as documented by AC-001/004/007/010/013. No 500s observed.

scenarios.description: V1 endpoints accessible without an Authorization header (DS-005 / R-004 non-regression).
scenarios.threshold: All 6 GET endpoints return 2xx without an Authorization header (none returns 401/403)
scenarios.details: GET /api/v1/{suppliers,staff,dealers,grades,designs,design-grade-map} all succeed without auth — DS-005 V1 invariant holds. If a future PR accidentally adds an auth middleware to V1, this scenario fails fast.

scenarios.description: Soft-delete preserves rows; FK references stay queryable (R-005 mitigation).
scenarios.threshold: After soft-deleting 1 supplier + 1 grade + 1 design + 1 design-grade-map row, 4 rows are still SELECT-able by their PKs (no DELETE happened)
scenarios.actual_value: 4/4 (100%) rows present after soft-delete with is_active=false; design_grade_map mapping's FKs still resolve to the soft-deleted design and grade
scenarios.details: After DELETE /api/v1/{suppliers/{id}, grades/{id}, designs/{id}, design-grade-map/{id}}, db_session.get() on each PK returns the row. The mapping's design_id and grade_id columns still reference the (now soft-deleted) parent rows — the historical join S2 reports need is preserved.

scenarios.description: PRD performance NFRs (dashboard < 1s, form save < 500ms, sales report < 2s) — DEFERRED to S3.
scenarios.details: S3 dependency. PRD non_functional.performance numeric targets all require the stock-ledger (M-003) and reports (M-004/M-005) which are not delivered in S1. test_cases.json open_items_for_sprint_gate explicitly notes 'Performance NFR PRD AC-045 (dashboard sub-second) is testable only after S3'. Tracked for /ases-system-test S3.

scenarios.description: Stock ledger concurrent-write race (R-001 mitigation) — DEFERRED to S3.
scenarios.details: S2 dependency. tbl_stock_ledger and apply_*() functions are not delivered in S1. DS-002's SELECT FOR UPDATE mitigation can only be exercised once the ledger exists. Tracked for /ases-system-test S3.
